name: Ram&Roll
questions: Which hand rolls are gluten-free as served, and do you have GF tamari?
Is the nori toasted or brushed with any soy or teriyaki glaze?
Are the truffle and yuzu toppings free of soy sauce and ponzu?
Is tempura fried in a separate fryer, and is the rolling station cleaned between orders?
Is the sushi rice seasoning gluten-free?

safe_dishes.note: Listed as a signature roll. Its GF status isn't stated, so ask for no sauce and bring your own tamari if they have none.

summary: The restaurant opened in late 2025. A promotional guide from around that time says the menu caters to gluten-free diners, but no dish-level GF information, tamari confirmation or celiac review was found.
tamari_source: Not mentioned. A Platinumlist guide only says the menu 'caters to gluten-free and vegetarian diners'.
